title: ר' אלעזר דמן רומא

paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar of Roma. Yochanan said in his name, Jerusalem Talmud, end of Gittin, Ha'omer; Pe'ah 5:2: Elazar Deromaya asked Yose. End of Yoma, chapter 6, and Chomer Bakkodesh: Deromya. Perhaps Yose ben Chalafta’s son Elazar, who went to Rome with Shimon. But unlikely: he asked unqualified Yose, ben Chalafta. He did not know a Roma exists in the Land near Sepphoris; see Yose ben Kisma and Yaakov Deromaya.
